title: Integrated Capstone for Technology and Information Design
description:
Prerequisite: Minimum grade of C- in INST204, INST367, INST380, INST406, INST454, and INST466.
Restriction: Must be in the Technology and Information Design program; and must have earned a minimum of 90 credits; and permission of INFO-College of Information Studies.
Jointly offered with: INST490, SDSI492.
Credit only granted for: INST490, INST491, or SDSI492.
